scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/local-host/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/extension/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: tsx --test packages/core/src/*.test.ts apps/local-host/src/*.test.ts apps/local-host/src/jobs/*.test.ts apps/local-host/src/storage/*.test.ts apps/local-host/src/platform/*.test.ts apps/extension/src/video/*.test.ts apps/extension/src/native/*.test.ts apps/extension/src/i18n/*.test.ts && node --test apps/local-host/scripts/*.test.mjs && pnpm test:package-manager
